input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or price/terms-matching obligation exists anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "most favored/favourable", "no less favorable", "lowest", "best price", "discount", "similarly situated" and "other customers" returned nothing, and the only pricing, revenue-sharing and payment provisions (Section 4 Fees, Exhibit B Pricing/Revenue Sharing Fees, Exhibit B Payment Terms) set fixed fees, fixed revenue shares and fixed payment timing with no obligation on Corio to extend Commerce One terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Section 2 (Grant of Rights) and Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation, expressly non-binding) likewise impose no MFN-type undertaking; Section 2.9/2.10 leave future products and geographic expansion to mutual agreement rather than benchmarked terms. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on the customer), so there is nothing to redline.
